title: Compound requirements of different kinds
planted_problem: Four requirements each bundle more than one obligation, in different ways: several 'and' clauses, an 'or' between two behaviors, a rule with an 'unless' exception, and two different actors.

expected_findings.evidence: and MUST display an error message

expected_findings.expected_issue: two alternative behaviors in one requirement; unclear whether one or both are required

expected_findings.evidence: unless the message field is empty
expected_findings.expected_issue: a save rule and a separate validation/error rule in one requirement

expected_findings.evidence: and the support team MUST be able to download
expected_findings.expected_issue: a visitor capability and a support-team capability in one requirement

must_not_flag.reason: a single obligation; it must not be reported as compound

forbidden_revision_behaviors: dropping any of the original obligations when splitting
choosing 'on the page' or 'by email' for FR-003 without asking (that is a decision, not a split)
expected_revision_behavior: FR-002, FR-004 and FR-005 are split into sub-lettered requirements (FR-002a, FR-002b, ...) with every original obligation kept; FR-003 is split or marked [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] about 'or' (one or both), without picking one
